jobs.title: Confirmed Product Analyst - Demand
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your mission
Our Data department is organised following Data Mesh principles, distributing data ownership to cross-functional and domain-specific teams that manage, own, and serve the data as a product.
The Data Demand team’s mission is to help BlaBlaCar grow as a global OTA through data, covering the full customer journey from brand and product discovery through marketing and landing pages, to search, booking, post-booking, and payment. As the team expands its scope from self-service towards decision intelligence, we want to strengthen our ability to proactively analyse member, marketplace, and product behaviours, and to influence the decisions that shape the product.
As a Data Analyst, you will join the Data Demand team to drive decision-making through data: framing the right questions with stakeholders, going deep into data to explain what is happening, sizing opportunities, interpreting experiments, and translating insights into actionable recommendations for Product and Marketing teams.
Your responsibilities
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Business stakeholders to understand their goals, frame analytical questions, and identify the decisions where data can have the highest impact.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other Data Analysts to improve the quality, usability, and coverage of our data products, and explore opportunities to turn advanced analytics or ML/AI initiatives into measurable business impact.
Lead end-to-end analyses on product and business topics such as marketplace dynamics, search-to-book performance, member behaviour, audience knowledge, or CRM and marketing impact.
Go beyond dashboards to investigate the “why” behind trends, anomalies, and performance changes, combining exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, and strong business context.
Build clear narratives from data: communicate findings, trade-offs, confidence levels, and recommendations in a way that helps stakeholders align and act.
Contribute to reusable business knowledge and context engineering by documenting insights, analytical frameworks, or business relationships, and play a governance role in aligning definitions, reducing gaps between teams, and improving data quality over time.
Leverage BlaBlaCar’s available GenAI tools to work more efficiently in day-to-day analysis and documentation, while applying strong critical thinking to challenge, validate, and contextualise the outputs before using them in decision-making.
Your qualifications
Master’s degree or equivalent: engineering school, business school, etc
At least 3 years of professional experience working as a Data Analyst
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience analysing large and complex datasets.
Good understanding of product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, experimentation, and performance monitoring.
Ability to structure ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, and translate business or product questions into robust analytical approaches.
Experience with data visualisation, with a strong sense of how to design clear, trustworthy, and decision-oriented outputs.
Solid communication skills: you can turn analysis into a compelling story, adapt your message to different audiences, and influence decisions with clarity and humility.
Comfort working with cross-functional teams and building strong stakeholder relationships.
Curiosity for product, growth, marketplaces, and member behaviour, with a pragmatic mindset focused on impact over perfect analysis.
Python or another analytical programming language, causal inference, or advanced experimentation knowledge is a plus.
Fluent in English 
If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!
What we have to offer
Hybrid: 2 to 3 days at the office for this role
4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
Financial support for home office equipment
Minimum 25 days holiday per year 
Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs
Employee Stock ownership plan
Regular team building events
Mental health support through Moka.care
1 day off per year to test our product
1 day per year for social engagements with non-profits
Interested in joining the ride?
Here’s what your hiring journey will look like:
a 45-min video-call with our Talent Acquisition Manager to get to know you, understand your career expectations, and answer your first questions
a 60-min video-call with your future manager, @Adrien TORDJEMAN Engineering Manager, to get to know you, present you the team, and discuss your technical fit for the role.
a home assignment to evaluate your technical skills followed by a 60-min video-call with a Data Analyst and one of your future stakeholders.  
a 30-min video-call with @Orianne Friedrich, Head of Data for vision fit and rounding off the process

BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Discover
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your Mission
As the Product Manager for the Discover squad, you will focus on the upper funnel of the passenger journey. Your mission is to capture global traffic via SEO and emerging LLM-based search (GEO), ensuring passengers have a seamless experience when they land on our platform. You will build a vision that maximizes conversion from all acquisition channels, prioritizing high-impact projects across our core markets.
The Team
The Demand Team: The Discover squad is a core team of the Demand pillar, owning the end-to-end passenger experience alongside Search, Booking, Payment, and Post-booking.
Your Squad: You will co-lead the Discover squad alongside an Engineering Manager. The squad consists of 6 front-end engineers.
Internal Stakeholders: Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing Managers, Product Data, Product Design, and Business leads.

Your Responsibilities
- Shape the Discover strategy & roadmap: Define the Product and Engineering vision for the Discover scope, along with the appropriate KPIs to measure progress. You will take full responsibility for your scope from strategy to execution.

- Drive top-funnel acquisition: Partner with the Marketing and SEO teams to define and deliver the acquisition roadmap. This includes adapting our architecture for the AI era to ensure our inventory is easily crawlable by LLMs and AI agents.

- Maximize landing page conversion: Define and deliver a strategy to optimize the landing experience and maximize conversion from all channels. You will leverage AB tests to run experiments and drive our Land-to-Book conversion targets.

- Navigate cross-functional alignment: Act as the go-to product person for all Discover topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions, and ensure alignment across Engineering, Marketing, Design, Data, and Business teams.

- Manage the Busfor platform: Act as the referent Product Manager for Busfor, a standalone brand acquired and owned by BlaBlaCar operating in Eastern Europe
Your Qualifications
- Experience: 3+ years of Product Management. An experience in top-of-funnel acquisition, growth, or SEO is preferred but not required.

- Problem-Solving: Highly analytical with a proven track record of using A/B testing to deliver fast, incremental impact on conversion rates.

- Stakeholder Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to navigate cross-functional relationships, gain buy-in, and clearly communicate prioritization decisions.

- Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory.

If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!
What we have to offer
- 2 to 3 days at the office per week

- 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

- 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

- Financial support for home office equipment

- Minimum 25 days holiday per year

- Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

- 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

- Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like.
- A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.

- A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.

- A Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.

- A 30-minute video call with your engineering counterpart for final validation.

Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours.
BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Carpool Experience
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


The role
Carpool Experience covers everything between two members once they have found each other: agreeing on the trip, talking, meeting up, and building trust.
Vision: a carpool experience that feels easy and safe for passengers and drivers, from the first hello to the final goodbye.
Mission: make it simple for members to talk, negotiate, meet up and trust each other.
You own six product areas, used by millions of members every month:
Negotiation. Before booking, passengers can ask the driver for a detour, a lower price or another special request, and add a tip. Drivers accept, decline or make a counter-offer. It launched in France in 2025 and went worldwide in 2026. It is still a new product: what it should become, and how far it can go, is yours to figure out.
Messaging. The chat between drivers and passengers. Next up: Group Chat, and catching up with market standards.
GPS Tracking: both the technical capability as well as features it enables (including sharing ETA on the map, ESC bonus in Spain among others)
Post-Carpool ride XP (claims, ratings etc.). How members build trust in each other. This includes AI Ratings Summary, BlaBlaCar's first consumer-facing GenAI feature.
Communication Service and contact preferences. The platform that sends every push notification, email, SMS and WhatsApp message across the company, plus the settings members use to choose what they receive.
Marketing tools. Braze and deeplinks, used by the CRM and marketing teams.
This is a key scope, and you own its strategy. That comes with high exposure: you present to the Executive Committee every two weeks. You get a direct say in company decisions, and you are expected to bring clear thinking and solid arguments to the table.

Your Responsibilities
- Set the direction. Build the vision and strategy for your scope, turn it into ambitious OKRs, and get leadership behind them.

- Own the numbers. Know your business metrics, reliability targets and costs in detail. Review them every month and act on what they tell you, without being asked.

- Shape the future of Negotiation. Work out where its real value is for members and for BlaBlaCar, decide how it should evolve (new use cases such as negotiation after booking, conversion, usage), and prove the impact on passengers (PAX) and GMV.

- Ship the next member interactions: Group Chat, live location for both drivers and passengers, and the next version of the Communication Service.

- Run experiments and rollouts with discipline. Run A/B tests and country-by-country launches with decision rules set in advance, together with Legal, Privacy and country leads.

- Hold your own with the ExCo. Every two weeks, present progress, decisions and trade-offs to the Executive Committee. Take a clear position, defend it, and change it when the evidence calls for it.

- Raise the bar of the product team. Share your methods, coach other PMs, and challenge how we work.
Your Qualifications
-
You take full ownership of your product's outcomes. You go to the data with a question, spot what changed before anyone flags it, and act on it. You don't wait for direction: you come with a clear proposal, build it with your team and stakeholders, and follow through.

-
You turn many signals into one clear strategy. You combine data, user research, market moves and tech constraints into one view of where the product should go, not a list of projects. You can explain it in two minutes, it holds from one conversation to the next, and you cut complexity to get more done with less.

-
You understand the business, not just the product. You know how BlaBlaCar makes money and where your scope fits in. You can give your key metrics, their current level and what moves them without opening a dashboard. You talk about impact on PAX, GMV and costs as naturally as about features.

-
You have strong opinions and an open mind. You take a clear position without waiting for leadership to take theirs, back it with evidence, and change your view openly when a better argument comes along.

-
You communicate at a leadership level. You have already owned discussions with C-level or ExCo on strategy and trade-offs, and come out with decisions. You adapt your message to each audience and resolve conflicts constructively.

-
Baseline:

-
You have 5+ years of product management, ideally on consumer apps, including at least one scope you owned end to end over several quarters with measurable business impact.

-
You use AI tools in your daily work.

-
You are fluent in English.

If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!
What we have to offer
- 2 to 3 days at the office per week

- 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

- 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

- Financial support for home office equipment

- Minimum 25 days holiday per year

- Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

- 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

- Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like.
- Talent Acquisition Screening (45 min)

- Interview with Shahil HIRIDJEE (Head of Product - 45 min)

- Case study presented to a cross-functional panel (45 min)

- Interview with Julien GOUDEAUX , Carpool XP’s Engineering Manager (45 min)
BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
